title: Versioned local DEM catalog admission and physical GeoTIFF terrain workflow

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name entries only; this batch connects existing operations to normalized DEM data, not new API names or complete GEE parity

implementation.catalog: Only local cop-dem-glo-30 with cop-dem-glo-30/v1 normalized collection/item metadata is admitted. Single elevation band in metres; no Google alias, arbitrary upload, Landsat or ERA5 admission.
implementation.source: Provider-shaped cop-dem-glo-30 single-band GTiff; original axis-aligned north-up EPSG grid cropped to actual source pixels without resampling; maximum4M cells. Ancillary preview assets are retained in source metadata but never read.
implementation.normalization: Finite scale/offset applied once through Float64 into Float32; valid0/-9999 preserved and source masks become NaN NoData. Explicit STAC/TIFF scale/offset/NoData disagreement rejects; STAC-only NoData adds a mask. Real numeric float32/float64 and integers up to32bits; complex,int64,uint64,nonfinite valid values and overflow reject.
implementation.provenance: Explicit timezone-qualified provider time; original interval/source version when supplied; source JSON checksum, native CRS/shape/affine, actual footprint, normalized COG checksum, EGM2008 and no cloud-mask claim. No fabricated date or source release version.
implementation.lifecycle: New normalization fingerprint; old immutable assets/snapshots untouched. Known failed publication cleans owned files; unknown DB outcome preserves files. Normal admin publication/snapshot/file/authorization paths unchanged.
implementation.metadata: Bounded pure metadata validation charged to the existing50000 compiler budget. Validated numeric EE timestamps/source IDs preserved through filtering, Image.load/first, properties and overrides. All-items scan precedes filterBounds; large catalogs may exceed this budget.

metadata_work.limit_scope: Per-item numbers exclude collection and subsequent expression/property work; no claim of1000-item acceptance or global catalog capacity

warnings.kind: Rasterio PendingDeprecationWarning for its internal Affine multiplication; existing warning category also exercised by new synthetic ingestion coverage, not vulnerability scan findings

official_clients.export: Explicit region, projected output CRS and scale pass existing pixel-budget and immutable selection/materialization controls

native_dem.scope: Synthetic source GeoTIFF normalized by gee.ingest.optical_item; official SDK graph compiled against captured local catalog metadata; exact selected item id and LocalEeTerrainSpec passed to standalone GeoTrellis numeric kernel; GeoTrellis wrote each output GeoTIFF and Rasterio independently read it back. No full graph executor, SparkContext, service, private data, or Google comparison.
native_dem.hillshade: Exact integer equality to independent Lambert reference, including0/255; physicalFloat64NaN
native_dem.grid_readback: Identical dimensions/CRS; coefficient-specific tolerance <=1e-10 relative cell size and <=32 coordinateULP; geographic pixel-width delta1.1018204577883939e-17, other deltas0
